advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm _load_scratch's os.getcwd() fallback cannot silently read scratch content from the wrong tree when repo_root_or_none() is None (co-located store, cwd outside checkout).
evidence: src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py:396: `scratch_dir = os.path.join(scratch_base, ticket_id)` then lines 398-413 read and parse files under scratch_dir — content, not just a displayed path
src/rebar/_config_resolvers.py:264: repo_root_or_none returns None when explicit/REBAR_ROOT/git-toplevel all fail
Pre-change base was `os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(tracker))` (removed line in diff), always anchored to the tracker; post-change it is anchored to cwd when repo_root_or_none() is None
advisory.finding: config.repo_root_or_none() returns None when neither an explicit root, REBAR_ROOT, nor a git toplevel of cwd resolves; in that case _load_scratch falls back to os.getcwd() and reads actual scratch CONTENT from `<cwd>/.rebar/scratch/<ticket>`, not merely a display path. Previously the base was deterministically `dirname(abspath(tracker))`. When the process cwd is not the checkout (and REBAR_ROOT unset), scratch reads silently resolve to the wrong tree and return an empty dict rather than the ticket's real scratch.
scenarios: A co-located store read where the process runs from a directory outside the checkout with REBAR_ROOT unset and no git toplevel — scratch silently reads as empty

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Verify the co-located store path is not regressed when cwd resolves to a different git toplevel than the tracker's repo and REBAR_ROOT is unset.
evidence: src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py:244: `cfg_root = repo_root_or_none()` — no longer derived from tracker
src/rebar/_config_resolvers.py:253-264: falls back to `git -C . rev-parse --show-toplevel` of cwd when REBAR_ROOT unset
Comment claims 'None == discover' equivalence, but discovery keys off cwd/git-toplevel, not the tracker — divergent when cwd's repo != tracker's repo
advisory.finding: The config-root reads in reads.py (ensure_fresh sync.pull/tickets.branch, _load_scratch scratch.base_dir), freshness._remote_ref, and fsck_tracker_health (_branch_mismatch fallback / _tracker_sync_status / _configured_remote_ref) now resolve the root via repo_root_or_none() — which ignores the passed `tracker` and depends entirely on REBAR_ROOT/cwd/git-toplevel. For a co-located store invoked from a cwd that is a DIFFERENT git repo (nested/adjacent checkout) with REBAR_ROOT unset, git-toplevel discovery can resolve a wrong-but-valid repo root, silently reading a different repo's rebar.toml (branch/remote/sync.pull) than the tracker's own. The prior tracker-anchored form could not misfire this way.
scenarios: Library/gate read of a co-located store executed from a sibling/parent git repo cwd with REBAR_ROOT unset — branch/remote/sync.pull resolved from the wrong repo's config
